edges.label: Co-founder and Executive Director of the Board

edges.label: Continuity from TTSA into the successor policy institution

edges.label: Senior Legislative Affairs Officer after 37 years on SASC
edges.note: A private foundation recruited the professional staffer who ran the oversight paperwork on the relevant committees; he then authored its April 2026 briefing arguing for a UAP whistleblower restitution fund.

edges.label: Co-founder, Executive Director and Secretary of the Board
